titleOptions.title: Night flight
titleOptions.why: Names the main appeal directly: flying a jet through the city at night.

titleOptions.title: City lights
titleOptions.why: Puts the illuminated skyline first. It suits the atmosphere, though it does not suggest jets.

titleOptions.title: Low flight
titleOptions.why: Fits flying between buildings. It says less about the night setting.

titleOptions.title: Above the city
titleOptions.why: Could refer to your jet or the alien ship. It suggests the setting without promising missions.

titleOptions.title: After dark
titleOptions.why: Fits the night setting, but is less specific to this game.

f16.name: F-16 Fighting Falcon
f16.blurb: The F-16 is a single-engine fighter. In this game, it turns quickly but cannot take much damage.

f18.name: F/A-18 Hornet
f18.blurb: The Hornet is a twin-engine fighter built for carrier operations. In this game, it handles well and has balanced armour and weapons.

f14.name: F-14 Tomcat
f14.blurb: The Tomcat is a carrier fighter with wings that sweep back. In this game, they sweep automatically as you speed up, but tight turns are not its strength.

mig29.name: MiG-29
mig29.blurb: The MiG-29 is a Soviet twin-engine fighter. In this game, it turns as quickly as the F-16 and takes slightly more damage.

f22.name: F-22 Raptor
f22.blurb: The Raptor is a stealth fighter. In this game, it combines high speed with tight turns and strong weapons.

f117.name: F-117 Nighthawk
f117.blurb: The Nighthawk is a stealth attack jet built to carry bombs. In this game, it is the slowest jet, with strong armour and weapons.

sr71.name: SR-71 Blackbird
sr71.blurb: The Blackbird is an unarmed reconnaissance jet built for high speeds and altitudes. In this game, it is one of the fastest jets, but needs the most room to turn.

protoA.blurb: This prototype interceptor has forward-swept wings and blue-lit intakes. It makes the tightest turns of any jet, but has light armour.

protoB.blurb: This hypersonic prototype has a long, flat body shaped like an arrowhead. It is the fastest jet available, but turns slowly.

protoC.blurb: This flying-wing prototype has four buried engines and two large gun pods. It is heavy and slow to turn, with the strongest armour and weapons available.

alien.blurb: The military captured this alien fighter and learned to fly it. It is fast and heavily armed, and turns as tightly as the most agile jet.

controls.heading: Controls
controls.keyboard:
Keyboard
W/S or Up/Down: Pitch
A/D or Left/Right: Roll
Q/E: Yaw
Shift: Boost
X: Brake
Space: Fire guns
F: Fire missile
C: Change camera
Esc: Pause

By default, W or Up points the nose down. S or Down points it up. Turn on Invert pitch to reverse this.
controls.controller:
Controller
left stick: Pitch and roll
LB/RB: Yaw
RT: Boost
LT: Brake
A: Fire guns
B: Fire missile
Y: Change camera
right stick: Look around
Start: Pause

By default, pushing the left stick forward points the nose down. Pulling it back points the nose up. Turn on Invert pitch to reverse this.
